sourceReview.installReview: Reviewed init, update, uninstall, template, and package lifecycle behavior. Init writes assistant skill files; update can install the CLI globally and refresh files with force; uninstall removes selected skill directories. package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare hook; prepublishOnly runs asset sync, data verification, typecheck, and build. None of those install/update/uninstall/publish commands were executed.

updateMethod: Review a pinned official commit and license, back up the full OpenCode skill tree privately outside discovery before any replacement, then compare and copy only changed owned files. The .agents symlink follows the OpenCode tree. The official CLI docs recommend updating ui-ux-pro-max-cli and running uipro init for a client; avoid that global flow when preserving this scoped, standard-library runtime. Refresh the existing Claude plugin through its own manager if its metadata version must be advanced; do not add a manual Claude skill copy.
rollbackMethod: No active skill tree was changed, so no backup or rollback was needed. For a future OpenCode tree replacement, restore the private full-tree backup to ~/.config/opencode/skills/ui-ux-pro-max; the .agents symlink will continue to resolve to it. Roll back Claude through its plugin manager, not by creating a second ~/.claude/skills installation.
